newsitem.title: BELGIUM: BELGIAN COURT SAYS VILVOORDE CLOSURE ILLEGAL.
newsitem.headline: BELGIAN COURT SAYS VILVOORDE CLOSURE ILLEGAL.

text.p: The Belgian Labour Court said on Thursday the decision by French carmaker Renault to close its plant at Vilvoorde near Brussels was illegal, Belga news agency reported on Thursday.

Belga said the court ruled that Renault broke the rules on worker consultation when it unexpectedly announced on February 27 that the profitable Vilvoorde plant would close in July with the loss of 3,100 jobs.
It said the court called on Renault and its workers to try to find a way to either avoid or at least reduce the collective sackings.
If Renault does not comply with the ruling, the court has to power to fine it.
The Vilvoorde workers have been fighting the closure, and have tabled plans to cut working hours in an attempt to keep the plant open at least until 2002.
But to date Renault has rejected any moves to keep Vilvoorde open more than a few weeks beyond the July 31 closure deadline.
